newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong's post-97 chief to visit Beijing.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong's post-97 chief to visit Beijing.

text.p: Shipping tycoon Tung Chee-hwa will fly to Beijing on Tuesday for his first meeting with top Chinese leaders since he was selected Hong Kong's post-colonial governor last week.
"My work has started. Tomorrow afternoon I will go to Beijing to be formally appointed," the leader-in-waiting told a business community dinner party on Monday.
Tung, who will succeed Governor Chris Patten at midnight next June 30 when the colony reverts from Britain to China, is likely to meet Chinese President Jiang Zemin on Wednesday.
Earlier on Monday, Tung was formally named the territory's first chief executive after the handover by Chinese Premier Li Peng.
